name: NextName
tagline: Look up domains, WHOIS, DNS, SSL, and TLD prices in one place.
description: NextName is a small domain research workspace I use when picking names. You can check if a domain is free, peek at WHOIS and DNS, see SSL status, compare registrar pricing, and browse TLDs. There is also a public API at /docs/api if you want to automate any of that.
